name: Two-Factor Email Code
description: Sent when a player picks the email option while signing in with two-factor authentication.
subject: Your {{serverName}} sign-in code
heading: Your sign-in code
body:
Use this code to finish signing in as {{displayName}}:

{{code}}

The code expires in {{expiresIn}} and works once.
text: Your {{serverName}} sign-in code is {{code}}. It expires in {{expiresIn}}.
footerNote: If you did not try to sign in, change your password: someone may know it.
